_comment: Milestone 1 jump configuration. Ramp geometry is relative to the vehicle wheelbase. Driver switch times are tuned to this scene + the RCCar stand-in; re-tune throttle_off_time/brake_time if you change geometry or vehicle.

vehicle._contact: SMC = compliant rubber-like contact (smooth, ~1 g cornering, faster); NSC = rigid contact (chatters / stick-slips at mu > 1). Effective grip = min(tire.mu, scene.friction).

camera._comment: Live-3D chase camera start view. angle_deg=90 => side-on view that follows the car (0=behind). In the window: arrows orbit/zoom, PgUp/PgDn raise/lower, keys 1-5 switch mode. Keyboard changes persist.

scene._friction: ground surface (asphalt-like); with SMC young_modulus is its contact stiffness [Pa]

driver._steering: piecewise-linear [t, cmd] schedule, cmd in [-1, 1], + = left. Default: straight through the jump, then a gentle left turn on the run-out.

controller._comment: On-board controller (src/firmware/ak_controller.c), used by the live server. control_every = physics steps per control period (1 => 1 kHz, 5 => 200 Hz). The Unity PhysX engine always runs its controller every 1 ms step. Speed mode: PI on the Hall speed estimate over speed_window seconds; gains in N m per rad/s (kp) and N m per rad (ki).

server._comment: Live simulation server for the Unity control panel (src/sim_server.py).
server._scene_overrides: applied on top of 'scene' for live driving only: a wider ground so you can steer around (the jump run keeps width 8).

sensors._comment: Simulated on-board sensors (src/sensors.py). mount_xyz is in the chassis COG frame (x fwd, y left, z up), metres. external.csv / internal.csv are written every log_every sim steps.

lidar._comment: VL53L5CX-like 8x8 multizone ToF on the front bumper, tilted down.
